decisive_items: Viral cytopathic inclusions (highlighted by CMV immunostain)
response.rationale: The presence of viral cytopathic inclusions highlighted by CMV immunostain strongly supports the diagnosis of CMV colitis, while the absence of abdominal pain and the specific histopathological findings make it more likely than ischemic colitis.

rejected.why: The presence of viral cytopathic inclusions contradicts the diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease.
